cohort.fullPlayLimit: PlaySim.run owns the engine natural finish/timeout; no collector override

definitions.actualExchange: An actual block_exchange emitted by the ordinary RunBlocker update; both target swaps, pre/post kinds/drives and next native solved OL loads retained.
definitions.ownPicture: Only sim.see calls consumed by the active observer were recorded by the unchanged collector. The partner own picture is explicitly absent, even if the controller called it.
definitions.kindDepthRule: For a recorded new-target image >2 yd beyond LOS, compare kind with climb; for shallower images, compare with the installed solo kind captured in initial plans. Combo installations use their installed owner kind. This is a descriptive controller rule check, not an NFL quality label.
definitions.retainedUpdateCounts: All-update-looking counts use retained collector rows only. This collector does not retain every ordinary controller update outside its existing diagnostic classifications.
definitions.reservedGuard: Each actual exchange requires both owners unengaged, no combination pointer, kinds outside pull/lead/stalk/draw, and both target defenders unengaged in recorded pre-update ownership.
definitions.sameFrame: Requested intent follows the new plan in the emitting update. Equality checks demonstrate the controller did not teleport body position/velocity or directly replace foot support; actual motion follows the native solve.
definitions.surfaceDrive: Recorded shallower-image exchanges compare post-update drive with that player’s initial installed displacement vector. A subsequent solo-zone read in the same update can legitimately choose a new vector; inequality alone does not prove a restoration bug. Initial combo/owner state is saved, not inferred from defender labels.
definitions.nativeUnits: Force kg·yd/s², impulse kg·yd/s, work kg·yd²/s²; SI force/impulse ×0.9144, work ×0.9144².
definitions.keeperCheck: Reuses pinned prior comparator’s actual surviving keeper hand-object IDs after the controller and next native solve; no raw nativeRecord duplication in this compact summary.

limitations: Balanced160 uses one generated roster pair31/32 and matched strength. Two roster41/42 witnesses remain separate; neither is an NFL concept distribution or population study.
Partner own images at exchange are not captured by this collector. Its rule execution needs independent tests/source review; no partner cognition is inferred here.
Changes to gains after exchanges include later coupled football decisions and contact; they are not isolated physical effects or an average NFL success target.
Recorded depth-rule mismatches are descriptive. Designed climbs can meet filling linebackers, and classification alone does not prove a better block.
Native limits apply to retained OL controller ticks; global work/momentum residuals were measured by the collector on every solved tick.
This comparison and collector overhead are not a solver speed benchmark.
